headline: Your Fitbit data can now connect directly to Apple Health
summary: Google is enabling direct Fitbit data syncing with Apple Health. The Google Health 5.05 update allows users to link workout, steps, and vital data. This integration streamlines fitness tracking across both platforms.

headline: Samsung’s discounted smart monitor is $349.99, its lowest price yet
summary: Samsung's versatile 32-inch 4K M80F smart monitor is now $349.99. This marks its lowest price ever, saving buyers $50 off the usual cost. The monitor combines TV and computer screen features, ideal for space-saving setups.

headline: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
summary: The EU's landmark AI Act began new transparency obligations on August 2nd. Companies must now disclose when users interact with AI models or AI-generated content. These rules aim to make it easier to identify chatbots and deepfakes online.

headline: The first-gen Kindle Scribe is a big e-reader and digital notebook that’s $150 refurbished
summary: The first-gen Kindle Scribe with Premium Pen is available for $149.99 refurbished. This 10.2-inch e-reader and digital notebook is perfect for students. The deal on the 16GB model runs until August 8th.

headline: The 27" LG UltraGear 280Hz Gaming Monitor Featuring Tandem OLED Tech Is on Sale Today for $399.99
summary: The 27-inch LG UltraGear 280Hz Gaming Monitor is on sale for $399.99. It features advanced Tandem OLED technology. Tandem OLED panels offer improved brightness and are more resistant to burn-in.

headline: Kevin Feige Reveals Why Marvel Fought to Keep Sadie Sink's Role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day a Secret
summary: Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige explained the secrecy behind Sadie Sink's 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' role. Marvel fought to keep the character a secret to maximize impact. Sink's mystery role in the comic has finally been revealed.

headline: Movie-Goers Evacuate Spider-Man: Brand New Day Screening After Viewer Lets 'Rotten' Fart Rip
summary: A screening of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' was evacuated due to a powerful odor. Audience members fled after a movie-goer emitted a 'rotten' fart. The incident turned the entire theater into a 'Dutch oven'.

headline: Sony's Spider-Man Spinoff Universe Might Be Dead as Company Confirms It Has No Movies in Active Development
summary: Sony's Spider-Man spinoff universe appears to be coming to an end. The company confirmed no new films are in active development. This follows poor box office and critical reception for titles like 'Madame Web' and 'Morbius'.

headline: Rapists and child sex offenders to be barred from early release scheme
summary: Rapists and child sex offenders will be excluded from an early release scheme in England and Wales. The decision follows public outrage, including from PC Andrew Harper's widow. She called it 'disgusting' that her husband's killers remained eligible.

headline: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
summary: Russia claims a Ukrainian drone strike on a busy Black Sea beach killed seven people. The attack reportedly injured 40 others, including three children among the fatalities. The drone crashed at a popular resort area.

headline: Infantino opponents threaten 'non co-operation' with Fifa
summary: Opponents of Gianni Infantino are threatening 'non co-operation' with FIFA. The English Football Association is set to join Wales in withdrawing support for his re-election. This signals growing dissent against Infantino's continued presidency.

headline: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
summary: Iran confirms ongoing talks with Oman but denies direct negotiations with the United States. This statement comes after Donald Trump claimed negotiations with Iran would resume. Trump subsequently issued a strong condemnation of Iran's leadership.
